children: McEwen announced its 46.3% investee McEwen Copper closed a $240 million senior secured 4-year term loan to advance Los Azules.
McEwen Copper closed a US$240 million senior secured 4-year term loan to fund engineering and early works at Los Azules.
Major participants: Sprott Natural Resource Investment Partners $112M, Rob McEwen $85M, others $43M.
Term loan bears 12.0% annual interest, monthly payments; principal due at maturity with 5% prepayment fee.
Lenders received 15,000 five-year warrants per $1M at a $40 exercise price as part of the financing.
Final investment decision targeted mid-2027; commercial cathode production targeted for 2030, subject to financing and approvals.
